summary: Provides ₹1,000 crore grant per park to build common infrastructure across 3 chemical hubs.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Cabinet Approves 'BHAVYA Rasayan' Scheme (₹3,030 Crore for 3 Chemical Parks). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Provides ₹1,000 crore grant per park to build common infrastructure across 3 chemical hubs.
Scheme Outlay: ₹3,030 crore financial outlay over 5 years (FY27 to FY31) from Union Budget FY27.
Park Requirements: Grant up to ₹1,000 cr per park (min ₹500 cr state contribution); min area 2,000 acres (8 sq km).
Chemical Sector Rank: India ranks 6th globally and 3rd in Asia in chemical production (contributes 7% to GDP).
BHAVYA Rasayan outlay (₹3,030 crore for 3 chemical parks) vs BHAVYA industrial parks outlay (₹33,660 crore).
